Articles

Figures

Figure essentials and colours

The conventions every bioToolkit plot shares: theme, fixed panel sizes, saving to PDF and PNG, legends, source data, gene names and colours.

Colour palettes

Every palette of bioToolkit with the index and hex code of each colour, its source, and the plots that use it by default.

Single-cell

Single-cell: embeddings

Where cell types, conditions, genes and scores sit on a UMAP: DimPlot_bioToolkit(), FeaturePlot_bioToolkit(), orienting an embedding and restyling plots made by Seurat.

Single-cell: expression across groups

Marker genes and expression per cell type or condition: top_markers(), DotPlot_bioToolkit(), VlnPlot_bioToolkit(), RidgePlot_bioToolkit() and DoHeatmap_bioToolkit().

Single-cell: comparing conditions

Does a condition change which cells are present, or where they sit on the embedding? summarize_group_meta(), get_meta_pivot(), plot_composition_scatter() and DensityDiffPlot_bioToolkit().

Bulk and differential expression

Bulk RNA-seq: samples and structure

From a count matrix to the structure of the samples: sample annotation, low-expression filtering, PCA, what drives the variation, group summaries and genes co-expressed with a gene of interest.

Differential expression: one comparison

Read a DE table from edgeR, DESeq2, limma or Seurat; volcano and MA plots; up- and down-regulated gene lists and ranked lists for GSEA.

Differential expression: many comparisons

Compare DE results across cell types, treatments, time points or assays: plot_multi_volcano(), plot_de_dots() and plot_fc_quadrant().

Gene sets

Gene-set enrichment

Plot over-representation and GSEA results from clusterProfiler, fgsea or the GSEA application: standardize_enrichment(), plot_enrichment_dots(), plot_enrichment_bars(), plot_enrichment_grid(), plot_gsea_rank() and format_gene_sets().
